messages:
tasha: Quick follow-up on the streaming/chat reliability incidents we've been seeing. Noticing a recurring cluster early Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC for the last 6 weeks (timeouts + partial payloads). Want to consolidate owners and timelines for short/mid/long term fixes.

ben: I logged the event set. 6 incidents in 8 weeks, similar stack traces around proxy EOF and abrupt upstream close. Suspect proxy memory pressure + model swap churn.

ryan: Can reproduce in staging when we combine concurrent long-lived streams + a model reload. The client sees partial responses when the server closes the socket mid-chunk.

noor: Draft remediation plan:
1) Short-term (reduce rate of customer impact): increase proxy stream timeout, add graceful close handshake (owner: ben).
2) Mid-term (architectural): implement connection drain + backpressure on model reloads (owner: ryan).
3) Tooling/ops: weekly recurring incident digest and automatic pattern-tagging in tracker (owner: tasha).
4) Telemetry: add last_byte_latency and socket_close_reason histograms (owner: noor).

amelia: I'll own customer comms for any affected accounts. Need a firm ETA for prod fix before I send the next batch.

ben: Short-term change pushed to canary: https://git.redwood/infer/proxy/pulls/501. Canary starts 2025-11-22 02:30 UTC. Monitoring dashboard panel added: `proxy.stream_close_rate`. Will watch for CPU/queue impacts for 72h. ETA for prod merge 2025-11-24.

ryan: I'll spec the drain protocol and a drained-sockets metric. Plan: stop accepting new streams on node -> wait for active streams to finish with max grace -> force close. PR draft by 2025-12-01.

noor: Telemetry ticket filed INF-812: https://tickets.redwood/INF-812. Will add histogram `stream.last_byte_ms` and `stream.close_reason` labels to help cluster by cause. ETA 2025-11-26.

incident-bot: Created recurring review reminder (weekly) and linked incidents: INC-2026-114, INC-2026-118. Owners assigned: ben, ryan, tasha.

tasha: Suggest we run a 30-minute ops review each Tue after the weekly digest for the next 6 weeks to see if pattern breaks. Need volunteer for rotation.

ops-oncall: I'll take the first two-week rotation and add it to the calendar.

amelia: Customer comms draft ready. Will hold until short-term prod merge completes and I confirm low error rates. Planned send: 2025-11-24 after prod merge.

ben: Quick logs snippet showing the error we see in prod:```
[2025-11-18T03:12:45Z] proxy=stream handler=close upstream=10.2.3.4:443 reason=connection-reset bytes_sent=1245
[2025-11-18T03:12:45Z] model=loader event=reload start
[2025-11-18T03:12:45Z] proxy=stream handler=partial-response client=acct-42 session=xyz123
```

tasha: Please add individual completion dates below (ISO) for tracking. If blocked, react with :raised_hand:. I'll capture the dates into the consolidated postmortem binder and set follow-up reminders.

ryan: Blocker: need model-team signoff on the drain approach for some of our quantized backends. Flagging @sophia for review.

sophia: Ack. I'll review the spec and test matrix by 2025-11-25 and call out any implementation constraints.

noor: Adding status comments to INF-812 and linking back to this thread. Completion dates: INF-812 -> 2025-11-26.

ben: Canary healthy after 24h. Moving to prod deploy window 2025-11-24 02:00 UTC. Completion date: 2025-11-24.

ryan: Drain spec PR opened: https://git.redwood/infer/engine/pulls/476. ETA for review: 2025-12-01.

amelia: Customer comms scheduled for 2025-11-24 post-deploy.

incident-bot: Reminder: update incidents with label `recurring-stream-pattern` and mark owners in the tracker.

tasha: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short consolidated follow-up (owners + dates + blockers) to the postmortem page and include the weekly digest. Reopen this thread if any regression appears.
